long_biography.plain_text:
After wartime Army service in Europe, Albert ‘Bert’ D. Phelps Jr. graduated from Babson College and began developing commercial property. He built a Fairfield shopping centre in 1955, then conceived a large office park on former industrial land in Norwalk. Phelps drained a cooling lake, relocated utilities, widened the road and altered the river to create the site, later bringing major corporate tenants to the district.

Phelps also developed retail property in Westchester County and managed his portfolio through an eponymous company. Sailing was a parallel lifelong pursuit: he competed successfully in offshore races and supported maritime education and youth programmes through charitable donations. He remained an active offshore sailor into his mid-nineties.
